nodes.title: Note: MiniMax H3
widgets_values:
# Mark DK Berry 

YouTube: [https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry](https://www.youtube.com/@markdkberry)

Patreon: [https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies](https://www.patreon.com/c/AIMakingMovies)

Workflows: [https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows](https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows)

---

## Latent Space Upscaler workflow

**Useage**: I made this specifically for dialogue clip upscaling as my other one doesnt work for mouth movements. This does.


NOTE: I prefer results from my pixel space upscaling workflow which is _"MBEDIT - MH3_r2v_SingleSampler_Detailer_vXX.json"_ and you can download it from here [https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows/tree/main/workflows_by_model/Minimax-H3](https://github.com/mdkberry/comfyui_workflows/tree/main/workflows_by_model/Minimax-H3)

but unfortunately that one doesnt do a good job with dialogue clips and fights mouth movements, even with good prompting. 

So, I created this workflow specifically for dialogue clips.

---

## ISSUES/THINGS TO BE AWARE OF

- **OOMS will hit you in the 2nd sampler, and are a PITA after waiting 20 mins to find out it cant handle it**. But if you have dynamic memory in, no switches, and dont dump the models during the wf, you should be able to tweak the Latent Upscaler down a touch and get through the 2nd sampler without a restart, so long as you dont change setting further back. Then tweak it better for next go.</br>

- I would prefer to set `ref_image_size` in the main H3 node of first part of run, to "Max" but often have to go with "Match" instead to avoid OOMs and get higher resolution faster.



---

## Upscaler Model For This Workflow 

You could install whatever ones you think are best. I tried some others but didnt find them to be as good as this one. This one still needed tweaking to get right, and might need different settings for your rig.

- [https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler](https://github.com/LBH-123-AI/Comfyui_Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)

- [https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler](https://huggingface.co/LBH-123-AI/Minimax_h3_latent_Upscaler)

---

## USING THIS WORKFLOW

It's not a v2v workflow like the pixel space upscaler _(see top of this note for that)_. This was created for upscaling dialogue clips.

***The following is for my 3060 RTX 12GB VRAM, 32 GB System ram as a guide for what to expect. Season to your tastes and setup.***

1. Set "H3 Reference to Video" node to resolution of 0.4 mp or higher if you can handle it. (for my dialogue clips I need at least 8 seconds, so its my limit vrs time)

2. Make a good prompt using the minimax prompt guide and an LLM, and provide your ref images for characters and scene.

3. Set the chunks to manage VRAM ceiling vrs Time. Set your speed Loras and speedups as required. (They change all the time so see other notes above).

4. set the Latent Upscaling node (LBH-123-AI notes will help you set it up) to whatever wont oom at your video clip length, longer it will take and more likely to OOM. I leave it at 0.8mp now as I stay under the oom for 15 and 20 seconds long clips at that.

# SPEED UP STUFF

## October 2026

SMD lora 4 step - str 1 - this is getting recommended for keeping audio and visual in tact. use it inplace of other speedup loras. It locks the camera and background down if you wanted that. but speckleds. [https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-4step-ComfyUI](https://huggingface.co/zjwfufu/SMD-MiniMax-H3-Ref2VA-4step-ComfyUI) **MBEDIT CONCLUSION: wasnt seeing improvements for my usecase over taomate in tests yet**.

DMAD - this can be layered with tao and used to try to improve quality maybe sound and visual. worked well for me. try 0.6 str when layering with tao and reduce tao to 0.6 str (from 1.). download from [https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/tree/main/loras](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/tree/main/loras)

LightVAE - this from Kijai - "the lightVAE works natively now too, it definitely has quality hit so wouldn't use it as encoder at all, and for decoding only as faster preview option." [https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental](https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental) **MBEDIT - CONCLUSION: not worth the bother in my case as I just run 3 steps for quicker tests and bump to 6 when going to 2nd sampler so not going to do a lot for my situation**

VEDA - faster than the native sol but does have a quality hit. (21 mins down to 14 mins for 15 seconds x2 samplers). install info from Benji future thinker here - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r39Ej4L2dO4 **MBEDIT CONCLUSION: VEDA losing quality on the 1st sampler a bit too much in basic use. going into the 2nd sampler eyes are crapping out too much. for fast storyboarding it makes it less useful as I need better quality on low steps in 1st sampler. If settings tweaks could improve speed/quality ratio maybe. but not solved yet.**

Taomate 3 steps - I am using this as fastest I found, test at 3 steps finalise at 6 steps (plus 2nd sampler) its not high quality its just good enough for my "speed over quality" fast storyboarding approach. (Kijai says it fails the stick test whatever that is and said, "Flashgen still hard to beat for me.")

Singularity model - not faster but has more cinematic feel allegedly, I am still testing it.

---

## Sept 2026:

- David Snow tested many and ended up on drbaphs step600_ema_pruned (from drbaph) lora saying "both 4 and 8 steps. Since that lora is quite powerful, I find a setting of about 0.4 is good with 8 steps. that's the sweet spot."

- Kijai version of flashgen 4 steps - https://huggingface.co/Kijai/MiniMax-H3-experimental/tree/main/loras.
worked best at strength 1 and steps 6. finished 10 sec video at 960 x 544 x 10 seconds in 540 seconds (about 10 mins). it was as long as drbaphs but slightly better quality (though could have been drbaphs was lower str?). I'll stick with this one for now for my sitcom useages which are lower res.

---

## August 2026

- SLA Attention comes from plagueKind and is very fast making 37 min run finish in 20 mins but it does degrade the result. Its best disaabled for good final result when upscaling, tbh. (no longer using it replaced by native version - Sept 2026)

- Lightx2v its 4 steps but I set it to 8 in sampler for best results. It makes a big difference to speed and I generally leave it in all the time the speed vrs impact is worth it.

- ComfyI Kitchen Attention I also leave this in and have replaced Sage Attn (2.2) completely with it now. Use one or the other.

- LowVRAM attention and Chunk feed forward. This is KJNodes stuff and I use them to get the best out of the VRAM ceiling. in this workflow I dont set it above 4 as the upscampler will max out the VRAM anyway and uses more than the first sample pass. you can raise chunks to 64 apparently but it will take a lot longer I expect. most I have done is 16. but it wont fix spikes. only the long term run ceiling.

VEDA SETTINGS:

For my 3060 I found the following:

32 default for sparsity both entries was too impacting but brought a 21 min run down to 14 mins. 

try 64 in both sparsity fields. was 16 mins for the same run but had some artefacting on face shadows.

try 96 for balance between speed and quality. (128 is completely zeroed out and will do nothing).

disable it if you want best quality.

check the command window for information on % it has dropped in a run.

## ISSUES:

dialogue can fail, if it happens disable it and try without VEDA.

# RefMod Info:

Installs from https://github.com/Luisacaotica/ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod

Setup Info : https://huggingface.co/datasets/malcolmrey/various/blob/main/h3-center/docs/MINIMAX_H3_REFMODS_INSTALLATION_AND_USAGE_GUIDE.md

More guides here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/malcolmrey/various/tree/main/h3-center/docs

---

## ESSENTIALS

If you save refmod with only 1 image it will save it as <Picture 1> and clash with your environment shot if you put that into <Picture 1> then things get weird. Solution, is to put your ref image into <Video 1> instead and target it in the prompt from that, while using <Picture x> to target the refMods. (you will need to provide 5 copies of the image to avoid error in the Video slot).

Note: if you use more than 1 image to make a refmod it saves it as <Video x> so the opposite will be the case. 

Also use the results you see from INspect H3 Refmod to work the prompt.

e.g. I save refmods out using only 1 image and audio file. this means they are targetted using <Picture x> not <Video x>. So I put the environment ref image into ref_video_0 slot and then target everything like this in the prompt:

```
<Video 1> is mdkb_v5_visual from <Picture 1> and elliot_v5_visual from <Picture 2> sitting in teal chairs on the set of a chatshow with red carpet and red background with screen showing the words "Psycho The rapist".

<Picture 1> mdkb_v5_visual using the London cockney accent from <Audio 1> mdkb_v5_audio says, "So what's it all about, Elliot?"
<Picture 2> elliot_v5_visual using the Canadian female accent from <Audio 2> elliot_v5_audio says, "I have no idea?"
```
